tree.heading: Appropriate congressional committees
tree.text: Except as otherwise provided, the term “appropriate congressional committees” means—

children.text: the Committee on Foreign Relations and the Committee on Armed Services of the Senate; and
the Committee on Foreign Affairs and the Committee on Armed Services of the House of Representatives.

children.heading: In general
children.text: The term “AUKUS partnership” means the enhanced trilateral security partnership between Australia, the United Kingdom, and the United States announced in September 2021.

children.heading: Pillars
children.text: The AUKUS partnership includes the following two pillars:
Pillar One is focused on developing a pathway for Australia to acquire conventionally armed, nuclear-powered submarines.

Pillar Two is focused on enhancing trilateral collaboration on advanced defense capabilities, including hypersonic and counter hypersonic capabilities, quantum technologies, undersea technologies, and artificial intelligence.

tree.heading: International Traffic in Arms Regulations
tree.text: The term “International Traffic in Arms Regulations” means subchapter M of chapter I of title 22, Code of Federal Regulations (or successor regulations).

notes.heading: Short Title
notes.text: Pub. L. 118–31, div. A, title XIII, § 1351, Dec. 22, 2023, 137 Stat. 514, provided that: “This part [part 3 (§§ 1351–1354) of subtitle B of title XIII of div. A of Pub. L. 118–31, enacting subchapter III of this title and amending section 8680 of Title 10, Armed Forces] may be cited as the ‘AUKUS Submarine Transfer Authorization Act’.”
